about: platform.md section 12: expected values for SeatPlannerTests, StowPlanTests, CarouselTests, RaySummonPickTests, ControlStreamTests, GovernorTests, DrawBudgetModelTests. Seat frame / room frame = Unity (x right, z ahead of the default seat, yaw degrees clockwise from above). Poses rounded to 1e-4 m / deg. An instrument was retired from the app (2026-11-10): its entry, its sets, joins, rays and spot are dropped and the carousel steps follow the seven; the control vectors use the neutral prefix "lane". The VR room was turned to face the fire (2026-11-11, RoomFrame): the seat planner's room box is ROOM z -1.62..3.58 in the seat frame (the reference ROOM turned a half turn about the seat and slid 0.5 m back, 2026-11-12: the same plans and counts as the plain turn); every plan stays the same, only the candidate counts (nodes) of 14 sets changed (seat-planner.mjs re-run with the turned ROOM). The kit's rack toms and kick pad were spaced from the snare (2026-11-14, C# DrumSpec.Pieces / DrumsDefinition, Tools/SoundLab/platform/registry.mjs): their drums boxes follow and the three drums rays' dir follow the moved pick point; every plan, count and pick re-checked by the Layout tests. Stow spots, rays and furniture stay in room coordinates (the room frame).
